description: This file defines the ScriptHelper interface used within the OFBiz framework to facilitate scripting operations such as entity lookups, service execution, and logging.

classes.name: ScriptHelper
classes.description: An interface providing scripting utility methods for entity operations, service execution, and logging within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createServiceMap
methods.description: Extracts service input parameters from a map and returns a new map of parameters.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sets the event or service status to error with a message.

methods.name: evalString
methods.description: Evaluates a string expression and returns the result.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Sets the event or service status to failure with a message.

methods.name: findList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entities matching specified fields.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Finds a single entity by primary key, constructing the key from existing variables.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Finds a single entity by primary key, using additional fields and arguments.

methods.name: makeValue
methods.description: Creates a new, empty entity value.

methods.name: makeValue
methods.description: Creates a new, empty entity value with specified fields.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with input parameters.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with input parameters and additional arguments.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Sets the event or service status to success.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Sets the event or service status to success with a message.
